content.comment_body: I swapped my [article_no] for a different [article_no] and started experiencing issues. I can download my existing program onto the new device, but it does not run properly and online testing fails with an error: "Online test failed. The hardware type of [product_name] in [product_name] soft comfort does not match the connected device." I am using a [company_name] basic HMI panel, and the only change was switching devices for high-speed input, since the program ran fine on the previous model. My software is [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no]. Is there something I might be missing?

Which hardware version (FS) do your devices have -- the old [article_no] and the new [article_no]? It sounds like you changed from a standard [product_name] with earlier FS to a newer model (FS04). If this is the case, you need to select the correct device in your software's project settings and then transfer the modified program to the device.

You are correct, I swapped FS02 with FS04. Now the online test works but the program behaves incorrectly. Is there any change in FS04 that could cause issues with a program that previously worked on FS02?
That would be news to me. What specific problems are you seeing?

I can't specify the issues exactly yet since I haven't investigated after fixing the online test. The setup is meant to count conveyor movements (tracking links with a laser sensor), count brush passes using a "move complete" signal from a servo drive, and stop after a set number of passes. It moves the conveyor and brushes back and forth until the pass count completes. Previously with the old device, everything worked perfectly, but with the new one, the system starts the process and then the conveyor changes direction and continuously runs while the brushes stop. I'll double-check the outputs but don't think they are the cause. I'll investigate further tomorrow.
If a program ran perfectly on a [article_no] with FS02, it should work the same on the FS04 version. In my view, the error must be somewhere in the connected hardware, such as switched inputs.

Hi, I'm new to [product_name] Soft Comfort. When I attempt an online test, I get this error: "Online test failed. The hardware type in the software does not match the connected device." Can someone help me? I might be missing something. Many thanks.
More details are needed. Which LSC version do you use? What device is set in the project configuration? What exact model and order number do you have? Please specify the FS or firmware version.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter errors during online testing after swapping hardware versions of [product_name] Basis Modules using [product_name] Soft Comfort. The main issue arises when the software project's device selection does not match the actual firmware state (FS) of the hardware, causing online diagnostics to fail and functional problems even after correcting the mismatch.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect smooth compatibility and uninterrupted program operation when changing between hardware versions, with consistent performance and reliable online diagnostics.
